## Summary

I upgraded the `wasmer-wasm-interface` library to use wasmparser 0.121.0 (the workspace version) and rewrote the validation code for the new API.

**`lib/wasm-interface/Cargo.toml`**
- Changed `wasmparser = { version = "0.51.4", optional = true }` → `wasmparser = { workspace = true, optional = true }`, inheriting the workspace-pinned 0.121.0.

**`lib/wasm-interface/src/validate.rs`**
- Replaced the deprecated `ValidatingParser` / `WasmDecoder` streaming approach with `Validator::new_with_features`, configured via a `WasmFeatures` struct that enables `threads`, `reference_types`, `simd`, `bulk_memory`, and `multi_value` (all others via `..Default::default()`). `validator.validate_all(wasm)` handles the actual module validation and surfaces `InvalidWasm` errors.
- Rewrote the section-scanning logic to use the new `Parser::new(0).parse_all(wasm)` → `Payload` iterator, extracting imports (`TypeRef::Func` / `TypeRef::Global`), exports (`ExternalKind::Func` / `Global`), globals, function types (via `TypeSectionReader::into_iter_err_on_gc_types`), and function signatures — preserving all existing interface-checking behavior for global imports/exports.
- Updated the API surface changes: `Type` → `ValType`, `FuncType.params`/`.returns` fields → `.params()`/`.results()` methods, and removed the obsolete `form` debug assertions.

All 16 pre-existing tests in the package (parser + interface + the two validation tests `global_imports` and `global_exports`) compile and pass, with no build warnings. I did not touch anything in `tests/`.
